propositions: The audit page renderer at page.py:329 only accepts kind='operator-attested' when computing the lacking flag, but must also accept kind='non-codebase' to handle immutable historical events
Existing live store contains 827 COMPLETION_VERDICT events with kind='operator-attested' that will silently stop being flagged as lacking if the verifier switches to emitting kind='non-codebase'
The criterion kind field is unconstrained in the schema (no enum) and page.py is the only site in the codebase comparing it against a string value
Renderer must accept both kind values such that lacking=true when kind is either 'operator-attested' or 'non-codebase' AND met=false
Renderer must leave codebase-verifiable criteria unaffected regardless of which kind value accepts lacking criteria
